campaign: safe-c33 shared-contract establishment (E2 follow-on: the X509_VERIFY_POLICY extension-method i2r printers)
subphase: B49 starts the X509_VERIFY_POLICY mechanism (75 BLOCKED sites). The 75 are grouped by X509V3_EXT_METHOD callback family; the largest family whose dispatch is wholly ours, the 22 i2r sites, receives fn-level # Safety contracts and one dispatcher guard. The other 53 sites are enumerated and left BLOCKED. The discharge is NOT applied: CAMPAIGN-STATUS.json is untouched and the closure was not run.

candidate.base_commit_subject: evidence(ssl): withdraw the B46/B47 rows; the witness question is undecided
candidate.working_tree: uncommitted working tree on the base commit: 16 src/x509/v3_*.rs printer files plus src/x509/v3_prn.rs. No commit, tag, build or install was made; the source identity is the base commit plus the files_sha256 below.
candidate.note: No freeze tag was created. V1 census coordinates are retained in `line`; `line_current` is bound to files_sha256.

authority.header: include/openssl/x509v3.h.in:45-61 (the X509V3_EXT_* callback typedefs and the method struct)
authority.note: The authority decodes the extension octet string through ASN1_ITEM_ptr(method->it) and calls the first of i2s/i2v/i2r that is set. It does not check out, ext or the item pointer. The candidate refuses a NULL out/ext, resolves the item once and refuses a NULL item; those are recorded safety divergences (B49-R5, B49-R6, B49-R7), not authority behaviour.

chosen_family.why: Largest family. Every i2r site is reached only through X509V3_EXT_print (this crate) at src/x509/v3_prn.rs:341 after the row looked up from the extension NID; no other code path calls an i2r slot (grep of `(*method).i2r` finds only v3_prn.rs:267).

shared_contract: i2r slot contract stated on X509V3ExtMethod (src/x509/v3_lib.rs). X509V3_EXT_print resolves the row's own ASN.1 item once (ext_method_item, src/x509/v3_prn.rs:279) and treats a NULL item as a failed decode (:279-289); it refuses a NULL out or ext in its prologue (:254-256) and a NULL decode before the slot (:300-303); it calls i2r at :341 and releases the decoded value with the same item at :355. `ext` is exclusively the dispatcher's for the call: the callback must not free, retain or replace it. `out` must be a live BIO (the caller's obligation; the guard establishes non-NULL only).

dispatch_paths.lookup: X509V3_EXT_get(ext) at src/x509/v3_prn.rs:266 -> X509V3_EXT_get_nid (standard_exts[] binary search, then the dynamic ext_list)
dispatch_paths.decode: the row item is resolved once (ext_method_item, :279): None means the old-style d2i/ext_free pair; Err means the accessor answered NULL and the call takes the failed-decode path
dispatch_paths.decode_call: ASN1_item_d2i(NULL, &p, extlen, item) at :291-300, or method->d2i; a NULL result is refused at :300-303
dispatch_paths.slot: the first set of i2s/i2v/i2r wins (:274-343); the i2r call is f(method, ext_str, out, indent) at :341
dispatch_paths.free: ASN1_item_free(ext_str, item) at :355 with the same item the decode used, or method->ext_free
dispatch_paths.lifetime: ext_str is exclusively this frame's from decode to :355 and is live across the callback; the callback must not free, retain or replace it
dispatch_paths.allocator: no allocator is involved at the boundary: ext_str comes from the ASN.1 decoder on the CRYPTO_* seam; out is the caller's BIO

defect_class.existing: uncontracted unsafe fn definitions at 75 X509_VERIFY_POLICY sites; the i2r printer family had per-line SAFETY comments but no fn-level # Safety
defect_class.extension: the dispatcher called the row item accessor twice and passed its result (including NULL) to ASN1_item_d2i/ASN1_item_free, whose contracts require a live item; a decoded value could be released through a different item than it was decoded with

residuals.description: No Miri (Stacked/Tree Borrows), ASan, TSan or dudect run. The change adds pointer checks and one item-resolution helper around synchronous callbacks; no new aliasing model is claimed.

The dispatcher can check that the row declares a non-NULL item, not that the item is the type the i2r body casts the value to. A C caller may copy a public row, change its `it` slot and register the copy with the unsafe X509V3_EXT_add while keeping this callback; the callback would then read a value of another type. The row pairing is the registrar's ABI obligation, stated in every contract and not mechanically checked.
`out` must be a live BIO; the prologue establishes non-NULL only. Liveness is X509V3_EXT_print's caller obligation.
The decoded value is exclusively the dispatcher's and is released once at :355. The contracts forbid the callback from freeing, retaining or replacing it; all 22 bodies retain nothing.
A NULL `out` or `ext` is refused with 0 before the first dereference; the authority would fault. Observable return value for the non-NULL paths is unchanged.

The row's ASN.1 item is resolved once and the same pointer is used for decode and release. The authority expands ASN1_ITEM_ptr(method->it) twice; for the crate's own rows the values are identical, and for a caller-registered unstable accessor the candidate avoids a type-confused release.
A row whose item accessor answers NULL takes the failed-decode path without the authority's ASN1_item_d2i error-queue entry (TASN_DEC_140). The tested return values match.

The NULL-item guard is canaried on a live stack row, not end-to-end: reaching it through X509V3_EXT_print requires registering a dynamic row in the process-global ext_list, which no existing test does and which would race parallel readers under --test-threads=4.
The other 53 X509_VERIFY_POLICY sites are untouched and remain BLOCKED: i2s 11, v2i 10, s2i 9, i2v 7, r2i 6, print 4, audit 2, bitst 2, non-method 2. No contract or guard is claimed for them.
